title: Closeout summary: T8 Merge driver wiring and rechain repair
body:
## Agent Finish Summary

Implemented T8 merge-driver wiring and event-log rechain diagnostics. Plain init now installs merge.boreal-jsonl.driver in local Git config when Git is available, doctor detects and fixes missing/stale merge-driver config, doctor reports repairable merged event logs as log.rechain-needed and corrupt logs as log.corrupt without auto-fixing, and corrupt logs can still surface doctor JSON instead of failing during operation bookkeeping. Verification passed: pnpm check; focused vitest for merge-driver/event-log wiring; full pnpm test; git diff --check. Git checkpoint commit could not be created because this session's filesystem policy denies writes under .git, including index.lock, objects, refs, and config.lock.

Close reason: done
